topic: Simplicity at scale: integration beats novelty
angle: AI value shows up when you simplify the stack and fix the plumbing, not when you add more tools.
sourceTitle: Facilitating AI integration with simplicity at scale
linkedinPost:
Your AI roadmap is only as good as your data plumbing.

A recent piece from MIT Technology Review profiles how Jabil scaled AI by simplifying integrations across messy, distributed operations. The lesson isn’t “add an agent.” It’s “remove friction.” Connect the systems, kill the spreadsheets, and make signal flow.

From the front lines, I see two patterns:

- Companies that consolidate to a few backbone platforms can ship AI to production 3-5x faster than those juggling site-specific tools.
- The biggest ROI jumps come from standardizing events and decisions (e.g., “part shortage,” “late order”) so AI can act consistently across plants, regions, or channels.

My playbook: design for boring. Start with a canonical data model, one event bus, and 2-3 well-defined “decisions” you’ll automate end-to-end. Then add the fancy stuff. If your AI needs a swivel chair to move data between apps, you’re taxing value at every hop.

If your AI initiative feels stuck, don’t buy another tool—delete three.

Where is integration debt silently taxing your AI ROI today? #AITransformation #EnterpriseAI #AIStrategy #DigitalTransformation
